name: Corporeal Beast

mechanics.name: Swipe
mechanics.description: Its melee attack, thrown at whoever is standing closest.
mechanics.counterplay: Pray Protect from Melee. Everything it does other than magic is stopped by that one prayer.

mechanics.name: Stomp
mechanics.description: It stamps the ground, hitting everyone standing under it rather than one target.
mechanics.counterplay: Do not stand underneath it. Protect from Melee covers it if you must.

mechanics.name: Double Stomp
mechanics.description: The heavier version of the stomp, two hits landed one after the other, and the single biggest thing it can do to you.
mechanics.counterplay: Same answer as the stomp, and a better reason to keep off its tiles.

mechanics.name: Magic Attack
mechanics.description: Its ranged option, and the one attack Protect from Melee leaves you open to. It comes in three strengths.
mechanics.counterplay: This is what makes the fight a choice: Protect from Magic stops it but leaves every other attack landing.

mechanics.name: Dark Core
mechanics.description: A dark core drifts out and heals the beast for everything it drains from anyone standing near it.
mechanics.counterplay: Kill it, or spread out so it has nobody to drain. Leaving it alone undoes your whole kill.

_note: SKELETON, NOT LIVE-VERIFIED. Ids come from Jagex's own gameval names rather than guesses, but nothing here has been confirmed in a live fight. Provenance: gamevals from runelite-api 1.12.35 (net.runelite.api.gameval.*), because this cache download ships an empty GAMEVALS index (idx24) and ScanGameVal cannot read it; npc names, models, sequences and extents from the live cache (revision of 2026-08-06). Npc id 319, with the dark core (318 and 388, two npcs sharing model 11069) as an add detecting on npc-spawn. Animations are the CORPBEAST_* set, all unambiguous gameval names: SWIPING_ATTACK 1683, STOMP_ATTACK 1682, DOUBLE_STOMP 1686 and the three SPRITE_SHOOT sequences 1679, 1680 and 1681. All three shoot sequences are curated on one mechanic rather than three, matching the three projectile strengths. Projectiles CORP_SPIRIT_BEAST_WEAK_PROJ 314, MID_PROJ 315 and STRONG_PROJ 316 are curated because each carries an explicit _PROJ suffix in Jagex's own name, which is the bar for a projectile trigger in this wave; CORP_GROUND_STOMP 318 and CORPBEAST_DOUBLESTOMP_SPOTANIM 1687 are graphics and are left out, since a graphic trigger has no source actor to check (docs/DECISIONS.md D17) and discovery never revokes (D18). Note that spotanim 318 and npc 318 share a number and are unrelated; the npc is the dark core, the spotanim is the stomp's ground effect. THE DARK CORE PREVIEW USES ANIMATION 7980, npc 318's own standing animation, per docs/DECISIONS.md D26's prefer-the-idle guidance. Its sibling npc 388 carries a different standing animation (1688) for the same model, which suggests one is a reworked version of the other; both are curated as triggers so whichever the game spawns is caught. staticFallback is false on all five; whether each body animation reads has not been eyeballed in game. The collection log page is titled 'Corporeal Beast', matching 'name'.
